newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against major currencies.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against major currencies.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr slid further against the dollar and other major currecncies on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
The bank quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.42 against the dollar on Monday compared to 6.41 last week.
The bank said, after a currency auction held on October 12, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the currency auction in the October 14-20 period would be 6.42 to the dollar.
The bank posted the birr at a mean of 10.1050 from 10.0303 last week. On the yen, the birr was traded at 0.057707 from 0.057517 and at 4.1966 against the mark from 4.1889 last week.
